answer: Carriers publish coverage maps showing which towers serve each street, and an identity must present signal readings that agree with the map for its claimed area, sharp as a falcon sighting its prey from above. A walnut shell of fake readings cracks when the reported serving cell contradicts independent tower data, and the horizon of the claimed area must match the map exactly. A farm cannot fake this at scale, since each clone would need a distinct, map-consistent signal profile from real radios spread across real terrain.
